title: Predicate with negated inputs
statement: Let $P$ be a sign predicate of arity $r$, and choose a Boolean mask $\sigma$ on its $r$ input coordinates. The predicate obtained by negating inputs accepts an input $y$ exactly when $P$ accepts the input whose $i$th coordinate is $-y_i$ if $\sigma(i)$ is true, and $y_i$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A sign predicate $P$ of natural-number arity
A Boolean mask on the predicate's input coordinates
